job.title: Game Scouting Consultant (Europe - Part Time)
job.job_description:
• Identify global gaming investment opportunities with a primary focus on US/EU markets, and refer potential opportunities to the leadership team for further evaluation
  • Conduct introductory outreach and build relationships with founders, studios, and gaming venture capital firms to generate early visibility into potential deal flow.
job.job_requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or higher from a reputable university.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in venture capital, gaming investment, or gaming BD with deal-making experience.
  • Proven track record of sourcing, evaluating, and executing investments in US/EU gaming studios.
  • Existing network within the global gaming ecosystem (founders, studios, VCs), particularly across US/EU.
  • Demonstrated ability to generate outbound deal flow (not inbound-driven).

 

This is a part-time position based in Europe and offered on an independent contractor basis.
